title: Ottoman Heritage & Sweet Moments in Sultanahmet
summary: A 2‑day cultural break for a couple in their 30s who love Orhan Pamuk, Sami Yusuf, Ottoman history, calligraphy, coffee and sweets. The itinerary blends iconic landmarks, museums that echo literary and artistic interests, and cafés serving Turkish coffee and traditional desserts, all within walking distance of Sultanahmet.
tips: Buy a Museum Pass Istanbul for discounted entry to Topkapı Palace, Hagia Sophia and the Turkish & Islamic Arts Museum.
Wear comfortable shoes; Sultanahmet’s historic streets are paved with cobblestones.
Carry a small scarf for mosque visits; it can be used to cover shoulders if needed.
